blocks.content: • Recommend licensing terms for telecom operators.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TRAI recommends licensing terms for telecom operators to structure the sector.
It ensures technical compatibility between different service providers.
Regulating tariffs and ensuring transparency in tariff policies are major financial duties.
TRAI actively promotes efficiency in operations and monitors service quality for consumers.

blocks.content: • Ensure technical compatibility between service providers.

items: TRAI has the specific power to regulate tariffs and enforce transparency in telecom pricing.
Monitoring service quality and ensuring inter-provider technical compatibility are core regulatory functions often asked in exams.
